name: SSHI_Simplified
rationale: The FBR fails on S2 (heavy load) and S4 (weak excitation) due to the diode drop relative to the low open-circuit voltage. A Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor (SSHI) topology uses an inductor to invert the piezo voltage, significantly increasing the extracted energy and efficiency. I use a SYNC controller to flip the voltage at the peaks and a rectifier to charge the storage capacitor. A Zener diode is added to clamp the output to 3.3V to satisfy vmax on S3.
